Storefront and customer routes of the questions module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## POST /v1/questions/{id}/answer

Answer product question

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [AnswerQuestionDto](#answerquestiondto).

Responses:

- `200`: Answer added.
- `201`: no description. Body: object.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Question not found.

## POST /v1/questions/{id}/helpful

Mark question as helpful

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Marked helpful.
- `201`: no description.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Question not found.

## Schemas

### AnswerQuestionDto

- `answer` (string, min length 1, max length 5000, required).
